substantiveCommits.message: Enforce construction metadata binding in visual gate
substantiveCommits.purpose: Call the construction/material binding contract validator from visual-gate configuration validation and require the current capture binding at the core Visual Fidelity scoring entry point.

substantiveCommits.message: Document binding enforcement at visual scoring entrypoint
substantiveCommits.purpose: Make the direct scoring-entrypoint requirement, fail-closed ordering and failure injections machine-readable in the existing construction/material evidence binding contract.

issueFound.description: The scene/material capture-binding system existed and could invalidate stale receipts, but QualityBlockVisualFidelityGate.EvaluateVisualGate did not itself call ValidateLatestBinding. A direct CLI/reflection/core invocation therefore relied on editor monitoring or workflow discipline instead of a guaranteed fail-closed check at the final numeric scoring boundary.
issueFound.whyPrioritized: This defect could undermine the admissibility of Geometry & construction, Material/PBR, Weathering causality and Period authenticity evidence even when their reviewed category scores looked complete. Closing an automatic-fail bypass has higher score-gate value than adding another speculative source-side visual feature before real pixels exist.

changes: ValidateGateConfig now validates the construction/material evidence-binding contract.
EvaluateVisualGate validates the binding contract even for direct CLI/reflection invocation.
After exact render provenance is verified, EvaluateVisualGate requires QualityBlockConstructionMaterialEvidenceBindingQA.ValidateLatestBinding before category scoring or PASS can occur.
Added scoringEntrypointEnforcement describing the core evaluator, required validators and fail-closed-before-category-scoring rule.
Added direct-core-evaluator failure injections for missing/stale construction_material_capture_binding.json.
Updated expected failure so stale/missing metadata binding cannot reach category scoring or PASS.

failureInjection.case: render receipt exists but construction_material_capture_binding.json is deleted
failureInjection.expected: QualityBlockVisualFidelityGate.EvaluateVisualGate throws from ValidateLatestBinding before category scoring.

failureInjection.case: a bound scene or construction/material metadata source changes after capture
failureInjection.expected: The binding guard invalidates the authoritative receipt or ValidateLatestBinding rejects the live SHA-256 mismatch; the core evaluator cannot PASS.

failureInjection.case: caller invokes QualityBlockVisualFidelityGate.EvaluateVisualGate directly instead of the evidence-bound wrapper
failureInjection.expected: The same exact construction/material binding validation still runs at the core scoring entry point.
The evaluator proceeds to the existing render/temporal/category/critical-defect checks; the binding itself awards zero Visual Fidelity points.

verification.staticSourceReview: PASS for intended call placement and contract documentation. The core evaluator now contains ValidateLatestBinding after render evidence provenance validation and before visual_fidelity_evidence category scoring.
verification.gitCompare: Start head to substantive head is 2 commits ahead / 0 behind with merge-base equal to start head; only UnityProject/Assets/Editor/QualityBlockVisualFidelityGate.cs and UnityProject/Assets/QA/construction_material_evidence_binding_contract.json changed before this run record.
verification.limitations: No Unity 6000.3.0f1 runner/editor session is available on this branch, so compile/runtime behavior and failure injection remain pending. No render quality claim is made.

expectedVisualScoreImpact: Geometry & construction fidelity: evidence-integrity improvement only; current capture must be bound to exact scene/construction metadata before its reviewed score is admissible.
Material/PBR physical plausibility: evidence-integrity improvement only; exact material registry and linked contracts must belong to the same captured scene state.
Weathering/context causality: evidence-integrity improvement only; post-capture metadata edits cannot retroactively justify old pixels.
Period accuracy/scene authenticity: evidence-integrity improvement only; reviewed pixels and period/construction contracts remain from one sealed evidence generation.
Automatic Visual Fidelity impact: 0 points until native 3840x2160 Unity stills, pixel-exact 100% crops and sealed temporal evidence are actually rendered and reviewed.
nextBlocker: Unity 6000.3.0f1 compile/runtime. At first Runner availability, stop speculative expansion; compile this gate, inject missing/stale binding failures through the direct core evaluator and evidence-bound wrapper, then produce fresh synchronized 3840x2160 hero/frontal-equivalent, oblique and grazing evidence plus 100% crops and temporal probes. Score/fix real pixels only after provenance and metadata binding both pass.
